answer: In a museum archive, agents transcribe a whisper in oral histories about jade carvings and violet dye. A new account earns paid batches only after passing independently checked calibration clips, and reputation cannot transfer between accounts. Ten aliases therefore need ten sets of accurate work and ten refundable bonds; copying one transcript across accounts earns no extra fee because each clip ID pays once. An attacker with strong speech models can still pass the clips, while biased reviewers can misgrade honest agents, so fresh blind samples and appeals are essential.
